public.text: The intended scope includes clinical, logistics, community, outreach, temporary, mobile, and other public-health-relevant locations. This is broad and risks conflating facilities, service-delivery locations, organisations, sites, and temporary events.
public.suggestedRevision: Define a formal entity model distinguishing organisations, facilities, physical locations, service-delivery sites, mobile services, temporary sites, and events. Specify which entity types the registry governs directly.
